usefulness.rationale: The dossier conveys the core identity (Special Envoy for Global Food Security 2022–2025, Crop Trust Executive Director 2005–2012, lead role in the FAO Global Plan of Action, association with the Svalbard Global Seed Vault, 2024 World Food Prize), so a reader learns who Fowler is and his major roles. However, every dossier entry has the placeholder text "statement" rather than actual prose, and the entire evidentiary base is a single Wikipedia article, so depth is limited. No section acknowledges gaps, unknowns, or contested points, so remaining questions is low. Conversation readiness is weak: dates and titles are present, but there is no detail on current activities, positions, or talking points beyond titles. On overclaims: the dossier's seed-vault claim is carefully phrased as "known as the father of the Svalbard Global Seed Vault," which is attributed reputation rather than the unjustified "built the vault" conclusion, so it is not flagged; no dossier statement asserts more than its cited quote.
